issues: React warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' in Settings render — missing `key` on mapped list item.

action_items: Fix React 'unique key prop' warning on /admin/settings (Settings component list render).

Consider adding a visible disabled state or inline helper when audience=selected is chosen but no user_ids are entered — current behavior silently accepts (campaign saved as sent, status=sent, user_ids=None/[]) and fans out to 0 users with no delivery count, which can be confusing. Backend returned 200 'Campaign sent' toast even though 0 notifications were created.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminContent.jsx line 131: changing audience type via `setF({ ...f, audience: { type: e.target.value } })` wipes any sibling fields (user_ids, group, days) silently. Prefer merging: `setF({ ...f, audience: { ...f.audience, type: e.target.value } })` so values persist if user toggles types.

AdminContent.jsx body() silently serializes empty user_ids as undefined for audience.type==='selected' — backend accepts and creates a campaign that reaches 0 users. Validate client-side when audience.type is selected/group/active/inactive and show inline error if the dependent field is empty.
Settings page: missing key prop in a list.map — causes React dev-mode warning on /admin/settings.

The frontend relies on cookies for auth but intermittently receives 401 on protected endpoints immediately after login (likely access_token not yet set when first XHRs fire); currently handled by React Query retry/refresh. Add a small guard: do not fire protected GETs until /api/auth/me resolves successfully.

pages/app/UserPages.jsx mobile OTP path couldn't be tested on seeded demo users (all mobile_verified=true). Expose a 'reset mobile verification' admin action or test with a freshly registered TEST_ user; current flow is implemented but not easily QA-able without side-effects.

rca of the issue: Audience=selected with empty user_ids silently delivers 0 notifications. RCA: AdminContent.jsx `onChange` for cmp-audience-select calls `setF({ ...f, audience: { type: e.target.value } })` resetting the whole audience; if the user then does not type into cmp-user-ids-input, `audience.user_ids` is undefined and body() leaves it out. Backend accepts and marks status=sent with no recipients. Mitigation: (a) merge instead of replacing audience object, (b) client-side validate dependent fields, (c) backend returns a 400 or at least a warning when audience is user-type-selected and user_ids is empty/missing.
